stem: Meena waters a potted money plant near its roots. After some time, the water and dissolved minerals reach the leaves at the top of the plant. Which row correctly shows the structure that carries them and the direction of movement?

options.text: xylem; from roots up towards the leaves and flowers
phloem; from roots up towards the leaves and flowers
xylem; from leaves down towards the roots
phloem; from leaves down towards the roots

teacher.key_rationale: Xylem vessels transport water and dissolved minerals absorbed by the roots upward to leaves, stems and flowers; phloem carries food (sugars) from the leaves, so only A is fully correct.
